correctness.rationale: For F_m the natural filtration, the exact Bernoulli step conditional success probability is pS_m/m. This gives E S_m=A_m and E[S_m|F_j]=(A_m/A_j)S_j. Independently the test function s(s+1) has conditional multiplier (1+2p/m), yielding E[S_{j-1}(S_{j-1}+1)]=2B_{j-1}. The marked identity I_j S_j=I_j(S_{j-1}+1) then gives E[I_jS_j]=2pB_{j-1}/(j-1), and division by P(I_j=1)>0 yields R_j. Conditional propagation proves the ratio for all m>=j and later k>j. Exact products prove R_{j+1}/R_j=1+p(1-p)/((j-1+p)(j+p))>1 for p in (0,1); gamma-product asymptotics give limit. Standalone Python exact rational exhaustive parent/retention enumeration through n=8 passed 145 assertions. Finite enumeration corroborates but does not substitute for infinite algebraic proof.

value.rationale: In independent bond-percolation of an ancestral recursive tree, success at an individual late-labelled vertex is the natural event used to predict subsequent root connectivity. The exact and permanently lag-free conditional amplification, its strict birth-age ordering, and a nontrivial explicit positive asymptotic ceiling answer a precise two-time reliability/influence question not captured by marginal cluster size or its scaling limit. These provide a usable positive-dependence kernel for labelled root-component membership, not an arbitrary numeric slice, a tiny asymptotic gain, or merely code verification. The derivation is short once the right quadratic factorial moment is identified; it is a structural exact fact rather than a claim of a new general urn law.
